Class OfferTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.board.OfferTile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class OfferTile extends Object implements Serializable
One of the totem-placement slots on the board, identified by a letter (A–G). Placing a totem on the slot grants its reward — a food bonus and / or the right to pick a fixed number of cards from the upper / lower rows. Some letters are unlocked only above a minimum player count. The isFree flag tracks whether the slot is still empty in the current round.
